Cracked desert hardpan at midday, flat white salt-plain stretching unbroken to distant mesa walls, mirage-shimmer dissolving the far base-line to liquid mercury, isolated wind-carved monolith columns casting near-zero shadow in the vertical sun.

Rust-tower graveyard at midday, decades of oxidation reducing the skeletal spires to deep orange and bleached-bone in the brutal sun, scrap-metal shrines and totems welded between towers, dust-haze softening the far colonnade to grey silhouette.

Acid-flat at night, toxic pools reflecting scattered stars and a fractured moon in iridescent oily ripples, rust-crystal formations glowing faint bioluminescent green, chemical-steam wisping in cold air, the silence broken only by distant structural groan.

Wasteland-spine ridge at dusk, long bare rock spine catching the last purple-amber light on its crest, the vast cracked hardpan spreading dark below on both sides, a column of scavenger-rigs moving along the ridge-line toward the dying light.

Cracked desert hardpan at golden hour, salt-glazed crust splitting into hexagonal plates stretching to distant mesas, heat-shimmer bending the rust-tower silhouettes at the horizon into liquid smears, a half-buried planetary lander foreground-right exhaling thin pressurized vapor.

Rust-tower graveyard at midday, skeletal processing-spires bleached bone-white on their windward faces and deep oxide-orange in shadow, scrap-shrines welded from salvaged plating clustered at each tower base, dust-haze threading the colonnade like slow smoke.

Salvage-yard graveyard at twilight, fields of wrecked crawler-rigs and sheared orbital-drop containers stretching horizon to horizon, a single waste-oil fire burning deep in the debris-maze, raider-pennants hanging limp from antenna stumps in the dying wind.

Dust-canyon at dawn, narrow slot passage with sun-bleached ochre walls rising fifty meters on each side, cold blue mist pooled on the canyon floor thinning fast as the first light hits the rim, distant energy-pulse flash visible around a blind bend ahead.

Collapsed mega-city ruins at dusk, far-future arcology skeletons half-swallowed by drifted sand rising from the flats, the jagged skyline silhouetted against a burning amber horizon, mutation-vine growth climbing the lower third of every standing structure in dense black tangles.

Acid-flat at pre-storm, iridescent teal and magenta pools reflecting a sky bruised purple-green, rust-crystal formations growing in organic clusters from the chemical crust, low chemical-haze drifting in ribbons across the terrain, the approaching storm wall turning the far distance into a solid dark mass.

Crashed orbital debris-field at dawn, fallen relay-satellites and re-entry drop-pods half-buried at impact angles in pale sand, thin smoke still rising from cooling heat-shields, three scavenger silhouettes visible at distance moving toward the newest impact crater in the blue-orange half-light.

Dune-sea at midday, rolling sand-crests bleached pale yellow under a white sun, a single set of crawler-tracks crossing the foreground dune like a scar, wind lifting fine particulate off every crest in streaming veils, a dust-wall building solid on the eastern horizon.

Hidden gulch oasis at twilight, narrow rock-walled gully with a brackish fuel-seep pool reflecting violet sky, two salvager tents wedged against the cliff face, cook-fire smoke rising perfectly vertical in the windless air, the open wasteland invisible beyond the gulch mouth.

Wasteland-spine ridge at golden hour, long fractured rock spine running across cracked hardpan terrain, dramatic high-ground vista revealing dust-canyons and a vast salvage-yard far below, a lone rig silhouetted small against the burning amber sky crawling along the ridge crest.

Rust-tower graveyard at night, oxidized spires reaching into deep-cobalt starfield, pale binary-moon light casting cold silver across the upper reaches, scavenger fire-pits glowing amber clusters at ground level, dust-haze softening every silhouette to a smeared edge.

Salvage-yard graveyard at dawn, wreckage piles emerging from ground-level mist in layered silhouette, crashed orbital habitat-module split open and picked clean dominating the foreground, first warm light igniting the uppermost debris-spires amber above the cold blue mist-sea below.

Dust-canyon at golden hour, walls glowing deep rust-red as angled light hits the upper faces, canyon floor still in blue shadow, wind-carved rock formations jutting into the passage mid-height, a raider camp fire visible as an orange flicker around the far bend.

Collapsed mega-city ruins at pre-storm, arcology tower skeletons disappearing into a green-black storm ceiling pressing down from above, mutation-growth forests covering the ground-level ruins entirely, dust-devils spinning through the bone-structure mid-levels, lightning reflecting off shattered transplex cladding high on a distant spire.
